s05162.summary: Wired Detective Brandt takes Hale's call, spotting inconsistencies about where he is.
A text warns she is not alone; her backup goes silent.
Hale arrives and admits he is coerced; a man behind her holds his phone.
Brandt sets the wire on the bar and turns to face the watcher.

s05164.summary: Mira rides a rainy night bus, a hooded man across the aisle.
Mira phones her father and accuses him of silence since Mom left.
The hooded man is Teodor, apologizing aloud; he asks her to say it to his face.

s05166.summary: Teens guarding a duffel in a laundromat spot Colt arriving.
Colt demands his stuff; Wren appears and the duffel spills flash drives.
Colt grabs a drive, Wren lunges, and police lights sweep the window.

s05167.summary: Lucas, Dr. Pruitt and Mrs. Abernathy hunt for the missing cat Biscuit.
Lucas finds paw prints leading to the locked staff door, which clicks open.
Deputy Harlow bursts in, saying a break-in call came from inside.
Biscuit the cat steps out wearing a tiny brass key.

s05168.summary: Pinned together in a stalled subway, Devin and Francesca realize they are bound for the same wedding.
Gus suggests they marry; both say no as the lights die.
Texts demand the cake; in the glow they study each other.
The train lurches on and everyone catches the sliding cake.

s05169.summary: Producer Abel challenges Clementine and Hux about slowing the bridge.
The waiting band asks if they are ready; Hux urges Abel to say yes.
Abel grabs his hat and heads out, ignoring Clementine.
Seeing the on-air light still lit, Abel says yes to the take.

s05170.summary: Nurse Priya sees a boy and a guarded woman waiting through the night.
Priya coaxes the woman to explain and offers to sit with the boy.
Names are shared as Denise relaxes; Toby jokes about Priya's badge photo.
Dr. Okafor invites Denise and Toby upstairs to see Grandma.

s05172.summary: Juno hears eerie thuds through her wall as her phone dies.
A neighbor garage band tuning up explains the noise; Juno laughs in relief.
Her closet door is open, and the voices whisper they are not in the garage.

s05173.summary: Dr. Lena tends a wounded man while a bleeding stranger guards a dryer.
Josie calls 911, security guard Abel bursts in, and Officer Kane storms in.
Everyone freezes as something in the dryer keeps running.

s05175.summary: During a blackout neighbors gather in Sal's kitchen; Big Dave arrives with ice.
Dave notes a woman with an umbrella standing on the drive for ten minutes.
Sal lets Ruth in; she was looking for her sister, and everyone welcomes her.

s05176_0.summary: Black water, fog, and a creaking hull at night.

s05176_1.summary: Nell presses a rag to bleeding Jonah and radios Dr. Sun.
Pete says he cannot operate again; Dr. Sun urges him to try.
A thump and dragging sound above, the bolted hatch shaking, then the lights die.

s05179_0.summary: Rosa cooks tortillas while Danny takes orders and Skye warns of an inspector.

s05179_1.summary: Chuy warns the propane tank is low and whistling; Rosa dismisses it.

s05179_2.summary: Inspector Wells arrives and Rosa spars with him about permits.

s05179_3.summary: Wells smells gas and spots a cracked hose Rosa denied.
Danny says the crack has been there since Friday; Rosa lashes out and refuses to leave.
Rosa cranks the valve but the pilot light ignites the gas in a fireball.

s05179_4.summary: Everyone escapes the fire and, surveying the wreck, laughs together.

s05182.summary: A band plays take fourteen in a storm-struck studio and stumbles on the bridge.
Talkback dies, rain leaks in, and an electrical whine climbs in the walls.
The band unplugs and tangles in cables as flooding water and feedback erupt.
A spark blows the lights and all five escape into the rain.

s05183.summary: Kim, Kip and a detective with a bleeding woman flee rising water.
Sora says to go up to the roof as a pipe bursts and darkness falls.

s05184.summary: Bea chides corgi Gus for stealing the garter, setting relay ground rules.
Bea and Gus race across the barn and tie at the ribbon.
Gus crowns Bea with the garter and Bea lets him.

s05186.summary: At Grandma Lucille's funeral reception, tension simmers between siblings Joni and Jory.
Siblings laugh over Lucille's terrible driving, a first relief.
Ames's text about the house surfaces; Joni admits Grandma sold it to her.

s05187_0.summary: CEO Rhea asks Tavi for a word and leads them to the glass room.

s05187_1.summary: Rhea tells Tavi that Series B failed and payroll is Friday.
A board member is coming up; Rhea asks if Tavi signed something.

s05188.summary: Pat, Patsy and Deacon Flint begin a support meeting with sibling sniping.
Deacon accuses Patsy of quitting and relapsing; shouting erupts.
A jar of pickles smashes and the shouting stops with a joke.

s05189_0.summary: Captain Voss watches deckhand Lin haul nets from an aging trawler.

s05189_1.summary: The Coast Guard warns Voss of a gale; his child begs him to come home.

s05189_2.summary: Voss orders Lin to cut six tons of catch as the storm nears.

s05190.summary: Corporal Voss scrutinizes Marta's papers and her violin case.
Marta pleads for her mother's rattling violin, appealing to his own mother.
Voss sets the violin down, lifts the barrier and lets them go.

s05191.summary: In a blackout, Denise and Gail joke about the frozen turkey.
A tipped candle lights a menu on fire and Raj douses it with lasagne.
They sit in the smoke and the lights return as the turkey thuds down.

s05192.summary: Sheriff Pike orders a chained protest at the mining bureau to disperse.
Scuffles erupt between protesters, the agent and deputy; Pike fires a warning shot.
The crowd retreats; Sam sits in the dirt looking at the dry sky.

s05193.summary: Two conspirators meet on a protest bench, Terrence showing a floor plan on his sign.
They share tea and wry talk about the protesters' conviction.
They fix the nine o'clock plan during the mayor's dinner.
They listen to the names of drowned towns, then Gordon leaves and Terrence holds his sign.

s05194.summary: Nell, Toby and Rosalind eye a stranger aboard their boat while arguing over selling.
Owen says he was dad's deckhand and knows where the deed is hidden.
The family exchanges looks and agrees to check the locker later.

s05195_0.summary: Mo slips into an empty gym and dodges a humming janitor.
Mo opens the trophy case and takes Big Dave's gold dumbbell.
Warned of a man outside, Mo sneaks past a screaming treadmill and the swimmer.

s05195_1.summary: Mo tosses the bag into the waiting van and it drives off.
